opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Setco sales to OEM’s estimated will be higher than the industry average due to  BSVI Channel and pipeline inventory restocking/build-back  Migration to larger size clutches (higher realization per unit) due to BS-VI norms" (concall ppt - 2021-08-01)

opportunities.point: Planned maintenance capex for Lava Cast is getting completed by H1FY22.

threats.point: FY21 saw a pandemic-induced crisis with frequent lockdowns, general economic slowdown, and fleet efficiency improvement due to GST and axle load norms.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Pandemic – induced crisis (Frequent Lockdowns)  General economic slowdown  Fleet efficiency improvement due to GST & additional 25% capacity due to Axle load norms" (concall ppt - 2021-08-01)

threats.point: Lava Cast faced teething problems including lower capacity utilization reaching a maximum of about 52% and high rejection rates of 17% to 19%.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Teething problems: LowerCapacity utilization (max achieved is only ~52%) and high rejection rates (~17% - 19%)." (concall ppt - 2021-08-01)

threats.point: Supply chain constraints affected production during Q3FY21.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Q3FY21 would have been much better, but supply chain constraint has affected the production" (concall ppt - 2021-02-01)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
